description: This file defines a utility enum VoiceWakePreferences for managing voice wake trigger words, including default values, encoding/decoding, sanitization, and display functions.

methods.name: decodeGatewayTriggers(from: String)
methods.description: Decodes a JSON string containing trigger words into an array of sanitized trigger words.

methods.name: decodeGatewayTriggers(from: Data)
methods.description: Decodes JSON data into an array of trigger words.

methods.name: loadTriggerWords(defaults: UserDefaults)
methods.description: Loads trigger words from UserDefaults or returns default trigger words.

methods.name: saveTriggerWords(_: [String], defaults: UserDefaults)
methods.description: Saves the provided trigger words array into UserDefaults.

methods.name: sanitizeTriggerWords(_: [String])
methods.description: Cleans trigger words by trimming, filtering, limiting length, and applying max count.

methods.name: displayString(for: [String])
methods.description: Returns a comma-separated string of sanitized trigger words for display.
